candidate.name: ASC36 oral tablets
candidate.summary: Ascletis reported initiation of an oral amylin-receptor peptide trial for obesity on 8 September 2026. The study plans single and multiple ascending doses in 86 participants with overweight or obesity.
candidate.formulation: Oral tablets; do not assign this trial phase to injectable formulations or combination programmes.
candidate.ukAuthorisation: Not established by this US trial announcement.
candidate.supply: No UK retail supply or stock established.
candidate.limitations: Sponsor announcement, not completed trial results. Reported weight-loss comparisons are animal findings and are not represented as human efficacy or superiority.

source.evidenceType: Original sponsor release distributed by PR Newswire
source.reviewMethod: Read release body including study design and animal-evidence limitations.
